title: Partition function
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the sign group, let $z$ be a sign vector of length $n$, and let $\pi$ map the $n$ coordinates to the $m$ coordinates. The partition function associated with $f$, $z$, and $\pi$ is the function on the $m$-dimensional sign cube that sends each sign vector $w$ to $f$ evaluated at the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $z_i w_{\pi(i)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the sign group
$z$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$\pi$ maps coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ to coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(m)$
